nodes.name: onboard.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the onboard command: a playbook for designing onboarding that gets users to first value quickly, covering assessment, progressive disclosure, empty states, and activation checkpoints.

nodes.name: optimize.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the optimize command: a frontend performance playbook covering Core Web Vitals measurement, bottleneck identification, bundle/image/runtime fixes, and verification.

nodes.name: overdrive.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the overdrive command: guidance for pushing an interface past conventional limits with advanced browser capabilities, scoped by context so effects serve the task.

nodes.name: polish.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the polish command: a meticulous final-pass checklist covering design-system alignment, spacing, states, typography, and browser-verified detail fixes before shipping.

nodes.name: product.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable register reference for product surfaces (dashboards, admin UIs, tools): defines the product slop test and principles for quiet, trustworthy, task-serving interfaces.

nodes.name: quieter.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the quieter command: how to reduce visual intensity in loud designs (palette, whitespace, motion, noise) without losing personality, split by brand vs product register.

nodes.name: shape.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the shape command: a design-planning workflow that produces a structured design brief (discovery, register, direction) before any code is written.

nodes.name: typeset.md
nodes.summary: Impeccable skill reference for the typeset command: a typography playbook covering font selection by register, type scales and ratios, hierarchy, line length, and replacing generic defaults.
